comment: No port families are given: the module routes whatever is patched into it, audio or CV alike. There is no in jack for the fifteenth row, because the bottom line is mono into stereo: one input, one send, two returns and two outputs. The plugin's own bypass mapping (configBypass) covers inputs 0 to 6 against outputs 0 to 6, so Rack's bypass leaves the bottom line's right output silent.
